title: ISO 10303-21 STEP loader smoke test
description: Loads an ISO 10303-21 STEP (`.step` / `.stp`) file through STEPLoader and renders one SceneObject per `PRODUCT` instance. Drop a real STEP at models/STEP_Sample/step/model.step and the example loads it directly; otherwise it synthesises a small AP214 fragment in-memory with six PRODUCTs so the example always renders something. Each SceneObject points at a single shared placeholder cube — a stand-in until the B-Rep tessellator that replaces those with real triangulated shapes lands.
